On a phone one pane shows, with no header. The title sits in the leftmost pane, and the stylesheet gives the page bar and the pane headers fixed heights.

title: Motion is shared and optional: every transition and animation uses the motion or hover tokens and is turned off under reduced motion
when: Reads every style rule in `app/src/styles.css` that sets a transition or animation.
then: Expects its times and easing to come from `--motion-speed`, `--motion-ease` or `--hover-speed`, and each such selector to be turned off by a `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` rule or to apply only under `no-preference`. Expects the tokens to be defined, and code that animates frame by frame to take its timing from `readMotion()`, which reads them and checks `prefers-reduced-motion`.

title: Nothing jumps, in the source: scroll boxes keep their gutter, bars have one height, counts are one text, canvases stay mounted
when: Reads `app/src/styles.css`.
then: Expects every vertical scroll box to set `scrollbar-gutter: stable` or hide its scrollbar, and the pane title above a canvas, the graph's trail and toolbar, and the Model view's caption and key to have a fixed block size or be one line. Renders the graph and expects its count to be one text after the depth, and its canvas to stay mounted when it re-centers. Reads the graph and Model view sources and expects what the graph connects to reach the host in a layout effect, and the ERD to be fitted before paint and to observe its size once. Moves to a record from outside the nav and expects the nav's domain row to stay closed and be marked, and opening it to open the branch down to the page. Reads `app/index.html` and `app/src/fonts.css` and expects no Google Fonts, the six latin files preloaded, every face `font-display: optional`, and each family's license beside its files.
notes: Also: the stability suite's scenarios (T71 to T78, T80, T81, T89, `LA-V93-R16-T03`, `T175`, `T202`), most of which are also the Workbench's view tests

title: In the Tree, Nested and Voronoi layouts, at every domain, stage and folder of every product, at depths 1 to 3 in two panes, siblings share one size and text scale and every drawn box shows its name

then: Expects the siblings in each map to be the same size (Voronoi cells within 10% of each other's area) with one text scale, every drawn box's label lines to give back its title and its kind and ID line, and the label to fit its box at its scale (a Voronoi cell's inside its outline). title: Each label line is placed in map units at its face's size times its box's text scale, inside its box, and drawn at that size times the zoom
when: For every box of the Tree, Nested and Voronoi maps of the test workspace.
then: Expects each label line's size to be its face's at text scale 1 times the box's text scale, and the whole line inside its box (a cell's inside its polygon), and every badge inside its box. On the page, expects each drawn line's font on screen to be its map size times the zoom, and a line under `TEXT_BAR_PX` drawn as a bar. Expects the canvas's measure to read each width once at its face's font, and the plain measure to be the same every time.
